ideas.name: 奇点铸炉
ideas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Premium original tabletop retrofuturist laboratory apparatus concept for MagicDesk. Explicit visual reference: Atomic Heart, elegant Soviet experimental biotechnology, ivory glazed porcelain, chrome and nickel structural anatomy, dark steel, sparse red enamel hardware, restrained warm amber/red optical energy. No copied game logo or prop.

The supplied image is the actual shared HELIOS pedestal. Keep this same pedestal exterior, stepped rim, circular diameter and height in all views. D=2.74 authored units; fixed base height .670608 = .245D. Do not increase its size, add floors, or make a wider platform to fit the new object. Use the same pedestal proportions and the same viewing angle. Only replace the upper egg and the middle control cassette. Common red X exit stays on the right; no separate menu button, selection is hidden in a flush metal rim segment. The upper device must visibly mount on the same deck.

Create an elegant landscape 3:2 charcoal studio concept sheet with THREE equal-width full-height panels labeled 'SEALED', 'ACTIVE', 'ASSEMBLY'. Same base size and same camera scale across all panels, clear spacing, no clipped objects. Model total height including base no more than 1.35D, active main geometry width no more than 1.5D. Fine material detail and clear industrial geometry. Intriguing science-fiction sculpture; not a claim of a real black hole or wormhole experiment. No floating base, no magic rune circle, no floating HUD, no blue-purple neon screen, no human hands or unrelated room. Exact overall title specified below.
Design SINGULARITY FOUNDRY, a contained black-hole fabrication device. The upper assembly is a compact inclined spherical vacuum chamber surrounded by THREE curved nickel containment ribs, with two thick asymmetrical ivory ceramic shielding shutters. A short heavy chrome saddle connects it to the unchanged pedestal. Two slender material-feed injector arms terminate at opposite sides of the chamber, visibly attached by pivoting supports. Own front controls: a deeply ridged compression wheel, a guarded red collapse lever, a square feed-pulse key and a tiny analog field-stability gauge; no row of seven identical buttons.

SEALED: two ceramic shield halves enclose the chamber with a narrow dark equatorial inspection slit; containment ribs interlock, injector tips retracted; still and ominous.
ACTIVE: shutters swing aside on visible hinges, exposing a perfectly BLACK small spherical center with an extremely thin blazing warm white/amber lensed accretion rim and a tilted restrained red-orange matter spiral. Black center must stay utterly black, not a glowing sun. Feed injectors send a few fine material strands spiraling inward; the surrounding physical containment ribs remain clear. Use a faint distortion contour of the far rim behind the black sphere as fictional gravitational lensing, compact and beautiful, no giant cosmic scene. Show pressure/stability hardware and real supports, not just a black hole hovering over a plinth.
ASSEMBLY: make the phenomenon disappear first; show empty chamber, two shields, three containment rib cartridges and two feed injectors separately offset along their mounts, with the shared base unchanged. An exploded MACHINE, never an exploded black hole.
Title exactly 'M  SINGULARITY FOUNDRY'.

Design BRIDGE ENGINE, a miniature wormhole simulator with exactly TWO mechanical iris gates. Each gate has an ivory segmented outer housing, thick nickel inner rim, visible iris shutter leaves, small red locking tabs and two-axis mounts. Gates are staggered FRONT/BACK as well as at slightly different heights on a connected curved chrome manifold attached to the common base; do not place them so far apart that the base must widen. Gate outer diameter about .40D each, total upper width about 1.15D. A thin supported sample track between the gate stations guides ONE small nickel probe bead. Own controls: two ceramic gate-rocker paddles, a ridged phase-alignment thumbwheel and a red bridge-lock lever, common separate red X at right.

SEALED: both iris shutters closed, gates folded partly toward one another, short probe track visible, bead parked at the near station.
ACTIVE: both iris gates open and orient slightly toward the viewer; each aperture contains a restrained warm amber distorted view of the OTHER gate's nearby mechanical structure, like two linked optical windows, not opaque blue sci-fi disks. A fine warm white/red throat contour connects their inner rims as a barely visible enclosed bridge. Show ONE probe bead half passing into the near iris with a fine trail, and a small reflected glint at the far gate indicating emergence, not multiple disconnected balls. Physical supports and connected manifold remain visible. Do not depict a space background or people traveling through.
ASSEMBLY: precisely two gate cartridges rise from their two mounts; iris leaf packs and gimbal bearings offset in coherent layers, manifold and unchanged pedestal remain. Both gates clearly belong to ONE compact device.
Title exactly 'N  BRIDGE ENGINE'.
